notes: Atlas rows 0 to 5 hold five colour variants of the same brave, packed as five consecutive blocks of 40 native cells starting at sprite 0.
Each block is 32 walk cells (8 directions x 4 frames) followed by 8 standing cells that are not part of the walk cycle.
The block colour is carried by the loincloth alone: block 0 has none and is the neutral tribe, then blue, red, yellow and green.

The direction order was recovered from the cell-width signature, which is mirror-symmetric in blocks of four: south_west mirrors south_east, west mirrors east, and north_west mirrors north_east. South and north are the two self-symmetric axes.
East and west were then assigned by inspection: direction index 2 leans and strides towards the left of the screen, direction index 6 towards the right.
Sprites 495 onwards, used before, are atlas rows 16 to 19: standing poses with a raised arm, not a walk cycle.
